answer: Each identity must stand on a mesa, reached only by a long climb. Honest mesas stand apart; a farm's are one plateau, cut into squares. On every mesa saffron must bloom, gathered thread by thread. Honest saffron is picked over seasons; a farm's comes from one field, dyed in one vat, one day. Every identity must complete a voyage, a long journey that leaves a wake. Honest voyages sail many seas; a farm's sail the same loop, the same tide, one hour. To pass, a farm must climb a real mesa, grow real saffron, and sail a real voyage for every puppet.
